title: Excellence scholarships

provider.name: Hamburg University of Applied Sciences (HAW Hamburg)

summary: Merit-based scholarships awarded to high-achieving international Bachelor's and Master's students studying at HAW Hamburg.

degree_levels.notes: Bachelor's students from the third semester onwards and Master's students from the second semester onwards.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines are eligible, except students in fee-based or continuing education programmes, or joint/double degree programmes entitled to funding from other sponsors.

institutions.notes: Must be enrolled at HAW Hamburg.

nationality.notes: Must have obtained higher education entrance qualification (HZB) abroad or completed a German Studienkolleg. Students with dual citizenship including German are not eligible. International students who are refugees cannot apply.

residence.notes: Must be enrolled as an international student at HAW Hamburg in Germany.

mandatory.text: Enrolled as an international student at HAW Hamburg (full-time and/or part-time)
Obtained higher education entrance qualification (HZB) abroad or successfully completed a German Studienkolleg
Bachelor's students: in third semester or higher and successfully completed at least 50 ECTS credits recorded in Transcript of Records
Master's students: in second semester or higher and successfully completed at least 25 ECTS credits recorded in Transcript of Records
Within the standard period of study for the degree programme
Must not have received the merit scholarship before, or received it no more than twice (can apply a third time; fourth award no longer possible)
Residency status pursuant to section 16 of the federal residency act (residency for the purpose of study) or EU citizenship
Must submit two recommendation letters from lecturers (for first-time applicants or if previous ones are older than 12 months)
Must apply via Mobility Online and submit CV, certificate of enrolment, transcript of records, copy of residency permit or passport/ID, bank account information form, and financial circumstances form

funding.description: Merit-based scholarships are awarded in the amount of at least €1,800 for one semester, paid out in installments.

application_rounds.notes: Deadline is March 30 of each year. The academic excellence scholarship is expected to be awarded for the last time in the summer semester of 2027. Extracted deadline was '03-30'; year not confirmed.
Deadline is September 30 of each year, portal opens 4 weeks before. Extracted opens_on was '09-01'; year not confirmed. Extracted deadline was '09-30'; year not confirmed.

recurring_deadline_notes: Summer semester deadline: March 30 of each year. Winter semester deadline: September 30 of each year.

required_documents.text: Current Certificate of enrolment from myHAW
Current transcript of records from myHAW
Copy of residency permit (non-EU citizens) or copy of passport or personal ID card (EU citizens)

steps.text: Approach lecturers for recommendation letters in advance
Register and log in using HAW ID in Mobility Online application portal
Upload required application documents to Mobility Online before the application deadline
Have referees send completed recommendation letters directly to io_scholarships@haw-hamburg.de

sources.title: HAW-Hamburg: Excellence scholarships
sources.notes: International students enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program at HAW Hamburg in Germany can receive student funding for studying physically in Germany.
